name: Countdown timer
purpose: Informs users that an event is about to be triggered and when, via a depleting circular indicator and/or a time value. Documented for browser.

props.name: style
props.$note: inline = ring + time on one line; stacked = ring with time stacked; undecorated = time value only (no graphic).

props.name: size
props.$note: inline: 210/222/234 wide × 32/44/56 tall; stacked: 88 wide × 82/94/110 tall; undecorated 166×26.

variants.name: inline
variants.use: Circular graphic indicator beside the time value.

variants.name: stacked
variants.use: Compact stacked layout (indicator + value), narrow footprint.

variants.name: undecorated
variants.use: Time value only, no graphic indicator.

graphicIndicator.name: .Countdown graphic indicator
graphicIndicator.use: Circular ring that depletes over time; documented time states 60s / 40s / 10s / 0s. Track = timer/background, depleting fill = timer/foreground. Colour does not change by time (no RAG escalation).

accessibility.announce: REVIEW (inferred): expose remaining time to assistive tech (e.g. role=timer / polite aria-live updates at sensible intervals) — don't rely on the depleting ring alone
accessibility.timingAdjustable: REVIEW (inferred): where the countdown triggers an action (e.g. session timeout), provide a way to extend/turn off/adjust the limit (WCAG 2.2.1)
accessibility.motion: REVIEW (inferred): respect prefers-reduced-motion for the animated ring

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): conveying the countdown only via the ring graphic without an accessible/textual time value
REVIEW (inferred): using a countdown to force an action with no way to extend the time

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.notes: Uses dedicated timer/background (#D7D8D6) + timer/foreground (#000000) semantic tokens, text/default for the value, font-5. Clean across inline, stacked, undecorated and the graphic indicator. specs/* annotation scaffolding ignored.
